| Time | Item | Owner | Output |

1. Stock-hypothesis treatment for advice.
2. Final performance-metrics list with time horizons and risk tolerance.
3. Frozen MP specifications (data, tuning, HCR, Buffer/K60).
4. Complete robustness-scenario matrix with pass/fail criteria.
5. Cross-platform validation owners and timeline.
6. Wageningen trade-off presentation format and decision-making protocol.

# Email reminder sequence

Three staged reminders. Each is short. Copy/paste blocks below.

## Reminder #1 — Friday 5 June (T-6 days)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Subject: SPRFMO SCW17 TG-05 (11 June, 15:00 CEST) — read-aheads due Mon 8 Jun 14:00 CEST
:::

Dear all,

A reminder that **SPRFMO SCW17 TG-05 — Pre-Wageningen Preparation Meeting** is Thursday 11 June, 15:00–16:30 CEST (Zoom/Teams). This is the last Task Team call before the Wageningen MSE workshop (15–19 June). The purpose is to **close** open items, not to reopen them.

The six items on the table:

1. Conclude the stock-hypothesis treatment.
2. Finalise performance metrics, time horizons, and risk tolerance.
3. Freeze MP specifications (data, tuning, HCR, Buffer/K60). No new MPs after TG-05.
4. Agree the complete robustness scenario matrix.
5. Agree cross-platform validation protocol and assign responsibilities.
6. Agree Wageningen communication and decision-making format.

Per the working-papers plan, the following are due **Saturday 6 June** and should appear in the shared folder no later than **14:00 CEST Monday 8 June** so members can read before the call:

- Full draft **SCW17-MSE-01** (Candidate MPs) — WMR + Chile + Peru
- Full draft **SCW17-MSE-02** (Performance metrics and trade-off framework) — Chair
- Full draft **SCW17-MSE-03** (Robustness testing design) — WMR
- Updated OM status note — WMR
- Slick / trade-off prototype if available — WMR

All current SPRFMO SCW17 jack mackerel materials are at <https://sprfmo.github.io/scw17/>.

If you cannot meet the deadline for the paper you lead, please flag it to me by reply today so we can plan around it.

Best,
Jim

## Reminder #2 — Tuesday 9 June (T-2 days)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Subject: SPRFMO SCW17 TG-05 Thursday 15:00 CEST — agenda + what each member should bring
:::

Dear all,

SPRFMO SCW17 TG-05 is in two days. Detailed agenda below; please review and bring concrete positions on the items in your area of responsibility.

**Agenda (90 minutes, strict time-boxes):**

- 15:00–15:05 — Opening
- 15:05–15:20 — Conclude stock-hypothesis treatment
- 15:20–15:35 — Finalise performance metrics, time horizons, risk tolerance
- 15:35–15:55 — Freeze MP specifications (no new MPs after this item)
- 15:55–16:15 — Agree complete robustness scenario matrix
- 16:15–16:25 — Cross-platform validation responsibilities and timeline
- 16:25–16:30 — Wageningen logistics and close

**What each member should bring:**

- **WMR (Iago, Karolina):** confirmation that SCW17-MSE-01, SCW17-MSE-03, and the updated OM status note are in the shared folder; the proposed MP register (one row per MP with data streams, tuning target, HCR, Buffer/K60); the proposed reference-set vs. robustness-set scenarios; the Slick / trade-off prototype if available.
- **Chile (Jose, Aquiles, Ignacio, Sebastian):** position on the stock-hypothesis treatment and, if applicable, on whether model-free / OpenMSE MPs from the Chilean contribution should enter the frozen MP register; commitment on Chile's share of the FLR vs. RTMB/OpenMSE cross-platform validation.
- **Peru (Ana, Criscely, Gersson, Erich, Daniel):** position on the stock-hypothesis treatment; commitment on Peru's share of cross-platform validation; any final Peru-specific input to robustness scenarios (e.g., Peru-acoustic uncertainty bands, far-north recruitment regime).
- **EU / PFA (Niels):** confirmation on performance-metric thresholds and risk tolerance from a Commission-decision perspective; any objections to the Chilean effort-creep treatment carried into the OM that must be tabled before Wageningen rather than at Wageningen.
- **Chair (Jim):** SCW17-MSE-02 final draft (metrics, horizons, risk tolerance); proposed Wageningen presentation format and decision-making protocol; the consolidated "exceptional circumstances" meta-rules note (one page).

::: {.callout-important}
## Ground rules for the call

- Items 2–4 are **CONCLUDE** items. If we cannot conclude, we adopt the documented fallback rather than spilling into Wageningen.
- No new MPs, no new metrics, no new OM axes will be added after this call. Items raised after TG-05 go to SC14 documentation, not Wageningen.
:::

All SPRFMO SCW17 materials are at <https://sprfmo.github.io/scw17/>. Joining link in the calendar invite.

Best,
Jim

# Fallbacks if read-aheads slip

If one or more of SCW17-MSE-01 / SCW17-MSE-02 / SCW17-MSE-03 is not in the shared folder by 14:00 CEST Monday 8 June, the chair will:

- **SCW17-MSE-01 missing or partial:** carry the MP set frozen at TG-04 into Wageningen and add new MPs only as side-by-side comparison runs, not as candidates for SC14 recommendation.
- **SCW17-MSE-02 missing or partial:** adopt the metric list and risk tolerance from the March working-papers plan verbatim; revisit only the time horizons during the call.
- **SCW17-MSE-03 missing or partial:** carry the reference set from TG-04 with the ENSO offshore-drop scenario as the only robustness axis, and flag the missing scenarios as Wageningen-week work.
- **Cross-platform validation:** if WMR/Chile/Peru cannot agree owners during the call, the chair appoints owners by name and confirms in the meeting minutes.

These fallbacks are deliberately conservative — the point is to protect Wageningen's schedule, not to penalise the leads.
